modalLead: A third way out of Inbox triage. "Keep" used to just mark a link read; now it saves it for good, to a new Unsorted page, with no category to pick.

items.text: Keep now saves the link, not just the read mark. It goes straight to a new Unsorted page — no modal, no category to choose.
Move to… can send a bookmark to Unsorted, and back. It sits in the popover beside your categories and other pages.
A widget and a full view. The widget shows what you kept most recently; the full view (Shift+U, or the new header icon) lays them out the same packed columns the tag filter uses.
A header icon, on by default. Turn it off in Appearance → Header if you would rather reach Unsorted only by key or from Move to….
